notes:
What's new in 3.5.0:
- Better shot coverage: the AI now gets a hard shot budget per segment instead of only a seconds target, so you get more, shorter, more varied shots (and it finally respects the shot count you ask for).
- Product板 is no longer one long static packshot: minimum 2 shots, none longer than 5s.
- Sharper camera direction: real lens variety (24-135mm, f/1.4-f/8) instead of the same telephoto every frame, explicit camera height/distance/angle, a mandatory physical event in story shots, and three concepts that actually differ by camera position, not adjectives.
- Duration counter: Script, Board and Render now show total seconds vs your target, in red when it drifts more than 10%.
- Fixed: the Board timing badge always compared against 15s, even for a 30s spot.
